lexicalSense.sourceSentence: It is also a system for connection, memory, and routine.

dependent.simpleMeaning: Needing something to work or be okay

lexicalSense.contextualMeaning: People who need their phones more have less thinking space
lexicalSense.sourceSentence: For example, one well-known study found that when people's own smartphones were present, they sometimes had less available cognitive capacity, especially if they were more dependent users.

design.simpleMeaning: How something is made or planned

lexicalSense.contextualMeaning: Results can change depending on how the study is planned
lexicalSense.sourceSentence: That means different studies do not always find the same result, and results can depend on the design of the research.

developing.simpleMeaning: Growing or getting better over time

lexicalSense.contextualMeaning: Science is still growing and learning about this topic
lexicalSense.sourceSentence: Good discussion should keep both ideas in mind: the phone can feel important, and the science is still developing.

digital.simpleMeaning: Using computers or phones, not paper

lexicalSense.contextualMeaning: Calendars on phones that help move plans from mind to device
lexicalSense.sourceSentence: Digital calendars, such as those used on many phones, show how planning moves from the head into the device.

lexicalSense.contextualMeaning: How far people should be from their phones
